'''''Example Film''''' is a 2020 science fiction film about a heist that goes wrong.
It was produced independently and later picked up for wide release.<ref>Some citation</ref>

== Plot ==
The crew breaks into a vault only to discover it is empty, [[MacGuffin|the device]] having
already been moved.

== Production ==
The film was shot in Iceland over six weeks.<ref name="iceland">Location scouting article</ref>
The director insisted on practical effects rather than CGI. See [https://example.com/interview interview]
for details. {{cite web|title=irrelevant template}}

=== Casting ===
The lead actor was cast after a nationwide search.
'''Jane Doe''' plays the protagonist.

== Reception ==
Critics praised the cinematography but were divided on the pacing.
